objects.name: ward_act
objects.description: What a ward's clinical leadership did, in the ward's own record. A ward is this domain's structure.

indexes.name: subject_history
indexes.description: Every act recorded against one patient, for the disclosure log a subject access request produces.

objects.name: record_event
objects.description: The clinic's audit trail of everything done to patient records as data.

objects.name: disclosure_job
objects.description: A disclosure build: the regulator's extract, or one patient's own copy of their chart.

objects.name: chart_access
objects.description: A clinician opening a patient's chart, which is logged whether or not anything was changed.

objects.name: consent_form_version
objects.description: One rendering of a treatment consent form.

objects.name: patient_consent
objects.description: A patient's signature against a treatment consent form.

objects.name: retention_hold
objects.description: A legal hold stopping a chart being purged while a claim is open. This domain's own object, filling no role the module declares, so no rule in the module touches it.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: The patient whose chart is held.

fields.name: lifted_at
fields.description: When it was lifted. Null while the hold is live.

indexes.name: live_holds
indexes.description: The holds still in force, which the purge sweep must consult before it deletes anything.
